# Diátaxis

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

A systematic approach to technical documentation, from Daniele Procida. It identifies four distinct needs of the people who use documentation, and four forms that meet them: tutorials, how-to guides, technical reference, and explanation. Documentation is organized around the structures of those needs.
